blurb: B.F. Clyde's Cider Mill is the oldest steam-powered cider mill in the United States, family-owned since 1881. Guests can watch historic steam-powered cider pressing, enjoy sweet cider, hard cider, and apple wines, and taste cider and wine in dedicated tasting areas. The mill also offers cider donuts, baked goods, local handmade products, and a gift shop with local crafts.
